---
title: "CRISPR-FlowFISH odds-ratio validation"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    df_print: paged
params:
  dataset: pbmc
  correction: false
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

project_root <- normalizePath("~/proj/EpiLink", mustWork = TRUE)
dataset_name <- if (exists("params")) params$dataset else "pbmc"
correction <- if (exists("params")) isTRUE(params$correction) else FALSE
correction_label <- if (correction) "correction_T" else "correction_F"
validation_root <- file.path(project_root, "results", "real", dataset_name, "validation")
figure_dir <- file.path(validation_root, "figures")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
source(file.path(project_root, "R", "validation_plots.R"))

correction_root <- file.path(validation_root, "CRISPR", correction_label)
metrics_path <- file.path(correction_root, "enrichment_metrics.tsv")
if (!file.exists(metrics_path)) stop("Missing CRISPR metrics: ", metrics_path)
metrics <- read.delim(metrics_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
if (!"celltype" %in% names(metrics)) stop("CRISPR metrics must contain a celltype column")
```

This report reads the already-computed CRISPR enrichment tables for one
EpiLink correction setting (`correction = `r correction``). It produces
exactly two publication figures in `validation/figures/`: an odds-ratio
trajectory and a 4-by-4 odds-ratio/95% CI panel plot.

## Summary

```{r summary}
summary <- aggregate(
  cbind(n_universe, n_selected) ~ celltype + method,
  data = metrics, FUN = function(x) x[1]
)
kable(summary, digits = 3)
```

## Odds ratio versus FDR cutoff

```{r odds-ratio, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
p_or <- plot_validation_odds_ratio(
  metrics, dataset_name, paste0("CRISPR (correction=", correction, ")")
)
print(p_or)
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, paste0("odds_ratio_crispr_", correction_label, ".pdf")), p_or,
       width = 12, height = 8)
```
